scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-black
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-16 for structural sections. Containers with borders must use internal padding p-8.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetric Bento). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4. Strict data density.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-md (8px) for a strict, disciplined academic feel.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px inner border border-white/40.
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders: flat background, border-collapse, subtle border-r border-b border-border/40, no shadow. Hover: slight lift, subtle shadow.
surface_strategies.marketing_cards: Neumorphism (Tactile): off-white bg, 1px sharp border-black/5, high-contrast text.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Scroll-triggered micro-interactions for statistics counters. Staggered entrance for course lists.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast on focus states.

components_instructions.general: Use raw HTML + Tailwind for creative marketing layouts (Hero, Bento Grids). Use Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, dropdowns, dashboards.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. High-contrast active states.
components_instructions.tables: Shadcn Table for Results, Rank Lists, Admin CRUD. Striped rows for readability.
components_instructions.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for Admin Dashboard analytics (selections, student growth).
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky nav with solid background/glassmorphism (z-50). Mobile-native hamburger.
components_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='enroll-now-btn').

page_specific_guidelines.home: Anti-Design Hero with open lead capture or bold CTAs. Trust-first elements (numbers, selections) immediately visible. Generous whitespace.
page_specific_guidelines.scholarship_portal: High visual hierarchy for registration form vs results. Use yellow accent for highlights.
page_specific_guidelines.dashboards: Control Room Grid. Strict monochrome with primary color only for active/actionable elements. No unnecessary padding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: `npm install @fontsource/cabinet-grotesk @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans` or use Google Fonts/local font files.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for headings.
Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' aesthetic. Heavily rely on monochrome structure (white, grays, black) and use Primary Blue (#002FA7) strictly for actions/highlights.
Ensure the hero overlay on images is max bg-black/50 (dark mode) or bg-white/40 (light mode). Do not obscure images heavily.
For the 'Centers' page, weave in the 'kashmir_landscape' image.
Ensure dashboards use Shadcn components extensively and follow the Control Room Grid layout.
Ensure data-testid attributes are included on all CTAs, inputs, and major interaction points.
